newsitem.title: UK: Hamleys to open 23 units at Debenham centres.
newsitem.headline: Hamleys to open 23 units at Debenham centres.

text.p: Britain's Hamleys Group plc said on Monday that it would open toy units at 23 Debenham centres, owned by the Burton Group.
Hamleys would trade from these centres on an all-year basis and would trade from another 28 Debenham centres during the Christmas season.
A Burton spokesperson said Debenhams would be charging a turnover-based rent from Hamleys but declined to give further details.
Hamleys' chairman Howard Dyer said the alliance with Debenhams would "produce a substantial increase in group sales.
Dyer said the investment requirements for this expansion would be restricted to working capital only and could be met from its existing cash balances.
